about: Where the authority for design lives. The signed and issued documents stay outside this public repository (D-03, D-08): this file points at them and copies none. `source` is relative to this folder, on the developer's machine. `sha256` is of the file named, taken on 6 October 2026. The order of authority is in design/README.md.

pack.name: Mizzey Launch Platform Pack MZ-02 REV4
pack.note: The client signed (reported by the owner on 4 October 2026). No countersigned copy and no signature date is on file. The signed PDFs below carry the Developer's signature.

sources.name: Services Agreement
sources.role: Governing engagement document. Sets the precedence between the documents (section 2.1).

sources.name: Statement of Work
sources.role: Governing engagement document. Section 9 sets the interface design: what it covers, its form as working HTML and CSS, and its revision rounds.

sources.name: Feature Register and Scope Definition
sources.role: Feature Register. The scope authority: every row, its wording, its scope value and its stage.
sources.in_repository: docs/scope/register-ids.json mirrors the ids, scope values and stages, without the wording.

sources.name: Functional Specification: User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
sources.role: Functional Specification. Stories and acceptance criteria per requirement. Issued for the Stage 1 review; approval pending. The register governs where it differs.

sources.name: E-commerce Website Requirements, the client's original requirements document, Arabic
sources.role: The upstream requirements every register row traces to by section number. Read for intent only: the register settled what is contracted.

sources.name: Acceptance and UAT Plan
sources.role: Acceptance. The definition of done, the acceptance script AC-01 to AC-25 and the store operations checks OPS-01 to OPS-08.

sources.name: Option B PBI ownership and exact register ids
sources.role: Which PBI accepts each delivery row. One row, one PBI.

sources.name: Owner decisions and open items
sources.role: Approved owner decisions, contradictions and working defaults. An owner decision is not a client confirmation.

sources.name: Sitemap and Principal User Flows, companion to the Functional Specification
sources.role: Verified sitemap and flows. Adds no scope. Its section 7 lists the open points it does not resolve.

sources.name: URL map, both languages
sources.role: The addresses the runtime serves in English and Arabic, asserted by the integration suite. Evidence, not a contracted deliverable.

sources.name: Technical Design, Architecture and Data Model
sources.role: Technical evidence, where it constrains design. Storefront editing through the block editor is its section 4.1.

sources.name: Delivered feature specifications and their verification records
sources.role: Technical evidence, where it constrains design: what the language handling, the addresses, the stock report and staging already do.

sources.name: Design Brief
sources.role: Background only. It adds no scope and contracts nothing.

sources.name: Option C material: scripts/stories.json, discovery/, Project 4 and its issues
sources.role: Historical reference only. Never scope, never a source for a surface, a flow or a wireframe. Option C was never signed.
